CSV
printf 'sales.csv created\n'

import csv, json, platform
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/hermes-flamepy-demo')
rows = list(csv.DictReader((p / 'sales.csv').open()))
revenue = sum(int(r['revenue']) for r in rows)
profit = revenue - sum(int(r['cost']) for r in rows)
summary = dict(rows=len(rows), revenue=revenue, profit=profit)
(p / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary))
print(json.dumps(summary))
print(platform.system())
